description.value: Pho Khang is an authentic Vietnamese restaurant in Richmond that has been serving house-made pho broth, rice plates, vermicelli bowls, banh mi, and hot pot since 2014. Located in a Number 3 Road strip mall, it offers a wide menu broad enough to satisfy most dietary preferences, including a dedicated vegetarian section. Online ordering with pickup and delivery, as well as reservations, are available for cyclists wanting a quick, efficient stop.
